analysis_prohibitions: no channel removal after observing outcome
no rerun because an outcome is uninteresting
no biological-function inference from divergence alone
no claim that matched-control divergence proves behavioral necessity

baseline_only_joint_analysis.indices: all action-vector indices 0..41 not belonging to the frozen 11 Live Fly v1 motor channels
baseline_only_joint_analysis.interpretation: descriptive passive-motion report only; no new motor-control attribution is permitted
baseline_only_joint_analysis.paired_field: first enabled/control exact measured-position divergence time_ms

channel_metric_definitions.command_to_measured_response_lag_ms: find the first paired neural transition where commanded_joint_targets differ exactly between enabled and matched control at the channel's action index; then find the first paired physics transition at or after that timestamp where measured_joint_positions differ exactly at that action index; lag is response_time_ms minus command_time_ms; null if either event is absent
channel_metric_definitions.enabled_control_physical_divergence: true iff at least one paired physics transition has an exact enabled/control measured-position difference at the channel's frozen action index
channel_metric_definitions.filtered_rate_distribution: sorted complete empirical multiset of all finite per-neuron filtered-rate samples for that channel across all neural transitions; no binning, rounding, or downsampling
channel_metric_definitions.final_contribution_distribution: sorted complete 1000-sample empirical multiset of final_contribution_rad for the channel; no binning or rounding
channel_metric_definitions.first_motor_population_activity_time_ms: first neural record in that condition where any recorded per-neuron spike increment for the channel is greater than zero; null if none
channel_metric_definitions.first_nonzero_decoder_output_time_ms: first neural record in that condition where raw_signed_contribution_rad for the channel is not exactly 0.0; null if none
channel_metric_definitions.first_physical_divergence_time_ms: first paired physics transition where enabled and matched-control measured_joint_positions differ exactly at the channel's frozen action index; null if none
channel_metric_definitions.nonzero_output_duty_fraction: number of neural transitions with final_contribution_rad not exactly 0.0 divided by total neural transitions
channel_metric_definitions.positive_negative_directional_balance: time-aligned neural-transition records containing pooled positive rate Hz, pooled negative rate Hz, positive activation, negative activation, and activation_difference defined exactly as positive_activation minus negative_activation before coordinate sign
channel_metric_definitions.range_clamp_occupancy: number of neural transitions with range_clamped true divided by total neural transitions
channel_metric_definitions.raw_contribution_distribution: sorted complete 1000-sample empirical multiset of raw_signed_contribution_rad for the channel; no binning or rounding
channel_metric_definitions.slew_limit_occupancy: number of neural transitions with slew_limited true divided by total neural transitions
channel_metric_definitions.spike_increment_distribution: exact integer frequency table over every per-neuron spike increment observed for that channel across all neural transitions; no bin merging

classification_rules.DECODER_OUTPUT: at least one raw_signed_contribution_rad not exactly 0.0
classification_rules.NOT_PHYSICALLY_DIVERGENT: no paired measured-position difference at the channel action index
classification_rules.OBSERVED_ACTIVE: at least one per-neuron spike increment greater than zero
classification_rules.OBSERVED_INACTIVE: no per-neuron spike increment greater than zero
classification_rules.PHYSICALLY_DIVERGENT: at least one paired measured-position difference at the channel action index

experiment: Live Fly v1 11-channel motor-output observability assay

pairing.between_condition_comparison: compare records having the same transition index
pairing.neural_physics_clock_rule: neural transition N must exactly equal the timestamp of physics transition 5*N within each condition

raw_telemetry_preservation.serialization_format: implementation-defined before authorization, but must preserve all recorded values without scientific transformation
